p: Praise waiteth for thee: You daily give new opportunities to your Church to praise you.
flesh come: Not only the Jews but also the Gentiles in the kingdom of Christ.
prevail against me: He imputes it to his sins and to the sins of the people that God who was accustomed to afflict them withdraws his help from them.
answer us: You will declare yourself to be the preserver of your Church in destroying your enemies, as you did in the Red Sea.
sea: As of all barbarous nations, and far off.
noise of the seas: He shows that there is no part or creature in the world which is not governed by God's power and providence.
visitest the earth: That is, with rain.
river of God: That is, Shiloh or the rain.
it: You have appointed the earth to bring forth food to man's use.
waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: By this description he shows that all the order of nature is a testimony of God's love toward us, who causes all creatures to serve our need.
they also sing: That is, the dumb creatures will not only rejoice for a time for God's benefits, but will continually sing.
